label: springtime13
title_zh: 死亡（以及其他悲伤的事）

lines.en: label springtime13:
scene chikabigmad1
: Like, seriously! What’s even the point of a Christmas party without Sensei?! He’s like, the only reason I get all dressed up and go to those in the first place!
lines.zh: 说真的！没有 Sensei 的圣诞派对还有什么意义？！他可是我特意打扮一番去参加那些派对的唯一理由！

lines.en: : Hey, remember back when you had a life {i}without{/i} everything having to be about that guy? Those sure were the days.
lines.zh: 喂，还记得以前你也有过不用什么事都围着那个男人转的日子吗？那可真是好时候。

lines.en: : Also, the hell you on about with “gettin’ dressed up?” Because I know you ain’t talkin’ about that skanky-ass Santa costume you keep stuffed in the closet 364 days out of the year.
lines.zh: 还有，「打扮一番」你到底在说什么？你该不会是在说那套你一年里塞在衣柜里 364 天的骚货圣诞老人装吧。

lines.en: scene chikabigmad2
: That’s {i}exactly{/i} the costume I’m talking about. And if it weren’t for Ami, I’d be wearing it again right now. Unless I’ve gained weight.
lines.zh: 我说的{i}就{/i}是那套。要不是因为 Ami，我现在就已经穿上它了。除非我胖了。

lines.en: : Have I gained weight? Is that why Sensei’s gone? Did he disappear because he didn’t have the heart to tell me and now Ami is helping him stay off the grid so I can’t learn the truth and win him back? Huh?
lines.zh: 我胖了吗？Sensei 就是因为这才走的吗？他消失是因为不忍心跟我说，现在 Ami 帮他躲起来，好让我永远不知道真相、没法把他抢回来？嗯？

lines.en: : You know, don’t you? You’re keeping something hidden from me. I can tell.
lines.zh: 你知道的，对吧？你在瞒着我什么。我看得出来。

lines.en: : Big sis, Chika! Can Chinami open another present?!
lines.zh: Chika 姐姐！Chinami 能再拆一个礼物吗？！

lines.en: scene chikabigmad3
: Of course, my precious little angel! Chinami can do whatever she wants because Chinami is a good girl who would never do anything to make her sister sad! I love you!
lines.zh: 当然可以，我的小天使！Chinami 想做什么都行，因为 Chinami 是个乖孩子，绝对不会做让姐姐难过的事！我爱你！

lines.en: : Wahoo! Material goods!
lines.zh: 哇哦！物质财富！

lines.en: : So, on a scale of one to ten, where do you think you’d rank yourself right now in terms of utter insanity?
lines.zh: 那么，从一到十打分，你觉得你自己现在疯到几分？

lines.en: scene chikabigmad4
: This many.
lines.zh: 这么多。

lines.en: : Aight. I think it might be time to take you to the doctor.
lines.zh: 行吧。我觉得是时候带你去看医生了。

lines.en: : You’re right. But if my lobotomy fails and I’m put into a coma, just pull the plug and take care of Chinami yourself. I trust you.
lines.zh: 你说得对。不过要是我脑叶切除手术失败、进了昏迷，你就直接拔管，替我照顾 Chinami。我信你。

lines.en: : I meant for like...brain shit, Chika. Whatever {i}this{/i} is ain’t healthy.
lines.zh: 我是说……脑子有病那方面，Chika。{i}现在这样{/i}可不健康。

lines.en: scene chikabigmad5

: Yes, Yumi! I’m well aware! If it was healthy, I wouldn’t be screaming like this and gaining weight and losing sleep and screaming and...did I mention gaining weight?! God, how bad is it?! Just tell me!
lines.zh: 我知道，Yumi！我很清楚！要是健康的话，我就不会像这样大喊大叫、变胖、失眠、大喊大叫……我刚刚是不是说过变胖了？！天啊，到底有多严重？！你直接告诉我！

lines.en: : You look exactly the fu...frickin’ same as always. Only difference is you finally went back to your natural hair color.
lines.zh: 你看起来跟平时一模一样，他妈的……一模一样。唯一的区别是你终于换回了本来的发色。

lines.en: : Oh god! It’s the hair, isn’t it?! That’s why he left!
lines.zh: 天啊！是因为头发对吧？！他就是因为这才走的！

lines.en: scene chikabigmad6
: Bitch, he ain’t even seen it yet.
lines.zh: 臭女人，他连看都没看过呢。

lines.en: : And he probably never will...
lines.zh: 而且他大概永远也看不到了……

lines.en: : Chika, the dude ain’t tryin’ to get away from you. He’s just...all messed up in the head. It’s probably like when I ran away for a while and he just needs some time to reset or something.
lines.zh: Chika，那家伙不是在躲你。他只是……脑子里一团乱。大概就像我之前离家出走那样，他只是需要点时间重启一下什么的。

lines.en: scene chikabigmad7

: But {i}why?{/i} I don’t even know what happened! It’s like, Halloween came and all of a sudden he was just {i}gone.{/i} And we all saw him leave with Ami that night, so it had to be something she did, right?
lines.zh: 可{i}为什么{/i}？我连发生了什么都不知道！就像万圣节一到，他突然就{i}没了{/i}。而且我们都看见他那天晚上跟 Ami 一起走的，所以肯定是她干了什么，对吧？

lines.en: : Frick if I know. Maybe he {i}also{/i} beat the shit outta Nodoka and just none of us were around to see it.
lines.zh: 我他妈哪知道。说不定他{i}也{/i}把 Nodoka 揍了个半死，只是我们谁都没在场看到。

lines.en: : Wish I was, though. That sounds hilarious.
lines.zh: 不过我倒希望我在场。听起来挺好笑的。

lines.en: : Yumi, I’m being serious. I’m starting to get really worried.
lines.zh: Yumi，我是认真的。我真的开始担心了。

lines.en: : You said that same exact thing after he was gone for literally one day.
lines.zh: 他才消失一天的时候，你就一字不差地说过这话了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but now it’s {i}justified.{/i} This isn’t normal. And all of us know it isn’t normal, yet no one’s been able to do anything about it and he’s still {i}not here.{/i}
lines.zh: 是，可现在{i}有理由了{/i}。这不正常。我们所有人都知道这不正常，可谁都无能为力，而他还是{i}不在这儿{/i}。

lines.en: : I...ain’t really sure what you want me to tell you, Chika.
lines.zh: 我……真不知道你想让我说什么，Chika。

lines.en: : I just know it ain’t good for you to keep freakin’ out like this. You’re gonna give yourself an aneurysm and then I really {i}will{/i} have to take care of the twerp on my own. And I ain’t ready to be a single mom.
lines.zh: 我只知道你老这么崩溃对你没好处。你会把自己搞出动脉瘤的，那我可就真的得自己一个人照顾那小鬼了。我可还没准备好当单亲妈妈。

lines.en: : What if he never comes back, Yumi? What if him and Ami just...up and leave?
lines.zh: 要是他永远不回来了呢，Yumi？要是他和 Ami 就这么……一走了之呢？

lines.en: : And go where? City’s closed.
lines.zh: 走去哪儿？城里封着呢。

lines.en: : Yeah, but the city’s {i}big.{/i} And Sensei is like, super charismatic and hard-working and awesome, so he’d be able to find another job {i}easily!{/i} He doesn’t {i}need{/i} to be a teacher.
lines.zh: 是，可这座城{i}很大{/i}。而且 Sensei 又特别有魅力、又勤奋、又厉害，他要另找份工作{i}轻而易举{/i}！他{i}不一定非得{/i}当老师。

lines.en: : You know, if the lobotomy thing and the crazy eyes didn’t already put you over the edge, that “charismatic and hard-working” comment would’ve. Dude’s a bum, Chika. You know it.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，就算脑叶切除那事和那双疯眼睛还没把你逼疯，刚才那句「有魅力又勤奋」也够了。那家伙就是个废物，Chika。你自己清楚。

lines.en: : Nuh-uh. He’s just been away for so long by now that you’re not remembering him correctly.
lines.zh: 才不是。只是他离开太久了，你记不清他什么样了。

lines.en: : You sure it ain’t the other way around?
lines.zh: 你确定不是反过来？

lines.en: : Is this really how my first relationship is going to end? With me never getting any closure and my boyfriend just straight up vanishing? Is my life really {i}that{/i} tragic? It can’t be, right?
lines.zh: 我的初恋真的就要这么结束了吗？连个了断都没有，男朋友就这么人间蒸发？我的人生真的{i}这么{/i}惨吗？不可能吧，对吧？

lines.en: : Like, something’s gotta work out eventually. Doesn’t it? Why can’t it be this? Why can’t it be him?
lines.zh: 总有什么事最后会好起来的吧？不是吗？为什么就不能是这件事？为什么就不能是他？

lines.en: scene chikabigmad8
: Chika...I know this ain’t what you wanna hear. But as your friend, I’ve gotta be honest.
lines.zh: Chika……我知道这话你不想听。可作为你的朋友，我得说实话。

lines.en: : Maybe fallin’ for a dude in his thirties while you’re still in high school wasn’t the best bet in terms of findin’ something that’ll “work out.” You know what I mean?
lines.zh: 也许在你还在上高中的时候，爱上一个三十多岁的男人，本来就不是什么「能有好结果」的选择。你懂我意思吧？

lines.en: : Age is just a number, Yumi.
lines.zh: 年龄只是个数字而已，Yumi。

lines.en: : Seriously? Around the kid?
lines.zh: 说真的？当着孩子的面？

lines.en: : Chinami, you didn’t hear that.
lines.zh: Chinami，你什么都没听见。

lines.en: : Chinami didn’t hear anything....
lines.zh: Chinami 什么都没听见……

lines.en: : Listen, I ain’t sayin’ he’s never comin’ back. I obviously don’t know him as well as you, but I don’t think he’s the type to just...leave all this shit behind, you know?
lines.zh: 听着，我又没说他永远不回来了。我当然没你了解他，但我不觉得他是那种会……把这一切都甩下不管的人，你懂吧？

lines.en: : But he’s done it once before. With Noriko. Which is probably why she’s handling this so well while {i}I’m{/i} drowning in misery.
lines.zh: 可他以前干过一次。对 Noriko。所以她大概才能这么淡定，而{i}我{/i}却在痛苦里溺水。

lines.en: : Pinkie ain’t doin’ well at all. Girl is doubling down on all that righteous nonsense she’s always pushin’ and I caught her cryin’ in the bathroom just last week.
lines.zh: Pinkie 可一点都不好。那丫头现在变本加厉地摆出她那套正义凛然的废话，我上周还撞见她在厕所里哭。

lines.en: : The one near the gym?
lines.zh: 体育馆旁边那间？

lines.en: : Yeah, the one near the-
lines.zh: 对，就是旁边那——

lines.en: scene chikabigmad9
: Wait, why do {i}you{/i} know that?
lines.zh: 等等，{i}你{/i}怎么会知道？

lines.en: : That’s the crying bathroom. It used to just be the gym bathroom, but our class took control of it in early November and repurposed it so we’d have a safe space to think about death and other sad stuff.
lines.zh: 那是「哭哭厕所」。以前只是体育馆的厕所，不过十一月初我们班把它接管了，改造成了安全区，好让我们有个地方思考死亡和其他悲伤的事。

lines.en: : Man, I can’t help but feel like a lotta this shit would be totally avoidable if we had an actual class counselor instead of the world’s most desirable predator.
lines.zh: 我说，要是我们有个正经的班级心理辅导员，而不是全世界最抢手的捕食者，这些破事里有很多根本就不会发生。

lines.en: scene chikabigmad10

: You want to talk about “predators?” Fine. Let’s talk about Ami — because there isn’t a doubt in my mind that this is all her fault. There’s no way she isn’t the reason Sensei’s still absent from school.
lines.zh: 你想聊「捕食者」？行。那我们来聊聊 Ami——因为我毫不怀疑这一切都是她的错。Sensei 到现在还不来学校，不可能不是因为她。

lines.en: : Heh? Don’t just assume I {i}want{/i} to talk about them because I-
lines.zh: 哈？别以为我{i}想{/i}聊她们，因为我——

lines.en: : Ten thousand yen says that clingy psycho niece of his is taking advantage of Sensei’s kindness as we speak.
lines.zh: 我赌一万日元，他那个黏人的疯子外甥女这会儿正在利用 Sensei 的善良。

lines.en: : She’s been doing it forever and I’m tired of giving her the benefit of the doubt just because I assumed making her like me would ultimately make it easier for me to marry Sensei after college.
lines.zh: 她一直都这样，而我受够了因为「让她喜欢我，大学毕业后嫁给 Sensei 会更容易」这种想法就一直对她网开一面。

lines.en: : But you know what, Yumi? {i}Fuck{/i} Ami. The next time I see her, I’m getting some answers — even if I have to squeeze them out of her damn neck.
lines.zh: 可你知道吗，Yumi？{i}去他妈的{/i} Ami。下次我见到她，一定要问出答案——哪怕得掐着她那该死的脖子挤出来。

lines.en: scene chikabigmad11
: Woah.
lines.zh: 哇哦。

lines.en: : Big sis Chika said the forbidden word! Now Child Services is going to come and take Chinami away!
lines.zh: Chika 姐姐说了禁词！这下儿童保护机构要来把 Chinami 带走啦！

lines.en: : Chinami, go take a bath. Big sis Chika needs to vent to Yumi or she’s going to pull all of her hair out and then she’ll be bald and ugly {i}and{/i} fat.
lines.zh: Chinami，去洗澡。Chika 姐姐得跟 Yumi 发泄一下，不然她会把头发全拔光，然后变得又秃又丑{i}又{/i}胖。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: 可是——

lines.en: : Chinami. No more presents until you take a bath. I mean it.
lines.zh: Chinami。洗完澡之前别想再拆礼物。我说真的。

lines.en: scene chikabigmad12
: Aww...rats.
lines.zh: 呜……讨厌。

lines.en: scene chikabigmad13
: Now...I ain’t the biggest fan of mini-Sensei either. But what makes you think she’d be the one somehow responsible for all this bullshit?
lines.zh: 话说回来……我也不怎么喜欢迷你 Sensei。可你凭什么觉得这些破事该算在她头上？

lines.en: : Were you not paying attention earlier! She left the Halloween party with Sensei and nobody has seen him since. She obviously did something.
lines.zh: 你刚才没在听吗？！她跟 Sensei 一起离开了万圣节派对，之后就没人再见过他。显然是她做了什么。

lines.en: : That ain’t true. We saw him the day after Halloween, remember?
lines.zh: 这不对。万圣节第二天我们还见过他，记得吗？

lines.en: : What? No. I don’t remember that at all. Stop making shit up just to throw a wrench in my theory. You always do that.
lines.zh: 什么？没有。我完全不记得有这回事。别为了给我的推理添堵就瞎编。你老这样。

lines.en: : I’ve...literally never done that at any point ever. But we had school that day, Chika. I remember because I was actually there.
lines.zh: 我……真的从来没有过。可那天我们有课啊，Chika。我记得，因为我确实在场。

lines.en: : Well {i}I{/i} was obviously not there because that never happened.
lines.zh: 那{i}我{/i}显然不在，因为根本没那回事。

lines.en: : The hell are you talking about? We even had that project thing where-
lines.zh: 你到底在说什么？我们那天还有那个小组作业——

lines.en: scene chikabigmad14
: Where...
lines.zh: 那个作业……

lines.en: : See? You can’t remember because it never {i}happened.{/i} If you’re going to make up stories like that, at least figure out the bullet-points before you start sharing them.
lines.zh: 瞧？你想不起来，因为那根本{i}没发生过{/i}。你要编故事，至少先把要点想好了再讲。

lines.en: : No, that’s...I can’t remember any of the details, but...I remember...
lines.zh: 不，那是……我记不清任何细节，可是……我记得……

lines.en: scene chikabigmad15
: A-Anyway, what about the rest of his little squadron?
lines.zh: 总、总之，他那个小队里的其他人呢？

lines.en: : Cause I know for sure that Ponytail and Blondie have been goin’ over to his place since they follow mini-Sensei home whenever she {i}does{/i} come to school.
lines.zh: 因为我敢肯定马尾和金毛去过他家，因为只要迷你 Sensei {i}来{/i}学校，她们就跟着她回家。

lines.en: : They {i}also{/i} left with him on Halloween. Sana too. I just left them out when I brought it up because Ami’s the one I trust the least.
lines.zh: 万圣节那天她们{i}也{/i}跟他一起走了。Sana 也是。我提这事的时候没算上她们，因为 Ami 是我最不信任的那个。

lines.en: : That entire group is starting to piss me off, though. They’re definitely hiding something. But any time I’ve approached Ayane about it, she’s seemed like...genuinely upset.
lines.zh: 不过那一整群人开始让我火大了。她们肯定在藏着什么。可每次我找 Ayane 问，她看起来都……真的很伤心。

lines.en: : So either Ami’s fucking {i}her{/i} over too or Ayane is going to win an Oscar one day. Maya and Sana I just...don’t even see being attracted to Sensei, as crazy as that sounds.
lines.zh: 所以要么 Ami 把{i}她{/i}也给耍了，要么 Ayane 早晚能拿奥斯卡。至于 Maya 和 Sana……说起来挺疯的，我真看不出她们会被 Sensei 吸引。

lines.en: : Is that really enough reason to wring her neck, though? Cause, speakin’ from experience, that’s a thing you’ve gotta be ready to deal with the fallout for.
lines.zh: 可这真的够格让你去扭断她的脖子吗？凭经验说，这种事你得准备好承担后果。

lines.en: scene chikabigmad16
: Honestly? If getting expelled is all that would come of it, yeah. I {i}do{/i} think that’s enough of a reason.
lines.zh: 说实话？要是后果就只是被开除，那没错。我{i}确实{/i}觉得这理由够了。

lines.en: : I’ve ignored Ami’s fucking...creepy incestuous passes at Sensei for way too long because I know he’d never go through with any of it.
lines.zh: Ami 对他那些恶心吧唧的乱伦暗示，我忍了太久了，就因为我知道他绝对不会真的做。

lines.en: : And if something actually happened that {i}did{/i} fuck him up mentally...and {i}she{/i} seized that opportunity to take what we {i}all{/i} know she wants from him...
lines.zh: 可要是真出了什么事、{i}确实{/i}把他精神上搞垮了……而{i}她{/i}趁机从他身上拿走了我们{i}都{/i}知道她想要的东西……

lines.en: : I will fucking kill her, Yumi. I mean it.
lines.zh: 我会杀了她，Yumi。我说真的。

lines.en: : Chika, you ain’t {i}killing{/i} anybody. And gettin’ expelled from school is gonna fuck with your future.
lines.zh: Chika，你不会去{i}杀{/i}任何人的。而且被学校开除会毁了你的前程。

lines.en: : You’ve got a little sister to take care of. You can’t be doin’ shit that {i}I{/i} would do. You’re better than that. You’ve {i}always{/i} been better than that.
lines.zh: 你还有个妹妹要照顾。你不能去做{i}我{/i}会做的那种事。你比那更好。你{i}一直{/i}都比那更好。

lines.en: scene chikabigmad17
: Yumi, let’s be real for a second. Getting expelled from high school won’t really do {i}anything{/i} to me or my future.
lines.zh: Yumi，我们现实一点。被高中开除对我、对我的未来其实{i}没什么{/i}影响。

lines.en: : I don’t have the money for college. And I was already considering getting my GED that year I left to focus on Chinami. Hell, I’m lucky they let me come back in the first place.
lines.zh: 我没钱上大学。而且我为了照顾 Chinami 休学那年，就已经在考虑考个同等学力证书了。操，他们肯让我回来就已经算我走运了。

lines.en: : Maybe if my mom was still here, things would be different. Maybe I’d be able to...I don’t know- work harder in school and...bust my ass for a scholarship or something.
lines.zh: 要是我妈还在，也许一切都会不一样。也许我就能……我不知道……在学校更用功，然后……拼死拼活拿个奖学金什么的。

lines.en: : But I don’t have the time for that while raising her with you. Neither one of us is...good enough at {i}anything{/i} to...{i}reach for the skies{/i} like Nodoka or Makoto...
lines.zh: 可我得跟你一起把她带大，没那个时间。我们俩{i}任何{/i}一件事都还不够好，没法像 Nodoka 或 Makoto 那样……{i}伸手摘天{/i}……

lines.en: scene chikabigmad18
: Plus, I’ve been making good money at the maid cafe. Especially with all the extra hours I’ve been picking up with Ami away.
lines.zh: 再说了，我在女仆咖啡厅赚得挺不错。尤其 Ami 不在，我还能接更多班。

lines.en: : Like, just look at all the presents I was able to get for Chinami this year. She’s having an {i}actual{/i} Christmas for once.
lines.zh: 就看看今年我能给 Chinami 买多少礼物。她总算过了个{i}像样的{/i}圣诞节。

lines.en: : I did that without even {i}finishing{/i} high school. Which means there are avenues for me to take care of us {i}without{/i} having to spend more time on my education.
lines.zh: 我甚至还没{i}读完{/i}高中就做到了。也就是说，我{i}不用{/i}再花时间在教育上，也有路子养活我们俩。

lines.en: : If anything, school is like...a {i}hindrance{/i} right now. Because I know I could be making even {i}more{/i} if I didn’t have to spend like forty hours a week there. You know what I mean?
lines.zh: 要说的话，现在学校反而像个{i}阻碍{/i}。因为我知道，要不是每周得在那儿耗上四十个小时，我能赚得{i}更多{/i}。你懂我意思吧？

lines.en: : I mean...yeah...
lines.zh: 嗯……是啊……

lines.en: scene chikabigmad19
: All that makes really good sense to me, Chika. Especially as someone who was thinkin’ the same way just a little while ago. Difference is that you actually {i}are{/i} good at shit, though.
lines.zh: 你说的这些我特别能理解，Chika。尤其是不久前我自己也是这么想的。区别在于，你其实{i}确实{/i}有擅长的东西。

lines.en: : And I don’t want you throwin’ away a chance at a better future for the sake of some dude who, again, don’t wanna say this — might not {i}be{/i} who you want him to be.
lines.zh: 我不想你为了某个男人就丢掉一个更好的未来——再说一次，我也不想这么说——他也许并不{i}是{/i}你想要的那个他。

lines.en: : I just don’t know what else to do, Yumi...
lines.zh: 我只是不知道还能怎么办了，Yumi……

lines.en: : I feel so fucking...{i}helpless.{/i} Like, she won’t even let me inside their house. I can’t even say I miss him. And he hasn’t responded to a single text in two months. I’m out of options here.
lines.zh: 我觉得他妈的……{i}好无力{/i}。她连他们家的门都不让我进。我连说句想他都不行。而且他已经两个月没回过我一条短信了。我真的没辙了。

lines.en: : You can always {i}wait,{/i} dude. We ain’t got the faintest fuckin’ idea what’s goin’ on with your creepy ass {i}boyfriend.{/i} And attackin’ his damn niece could make that even worse.
lines.zh: 你还可以{i}等{/i}啊，大姐。你那个变态{i}男朋友{/i}到底怎么回事，我们一点头绪都没有。而且去打他那个该死的外甥女，只会让事情更糟。

lines.en: : Like, the hell would you gain if you beat the shit out of her and she straight up just...continued to not tell you anything? Cause the best case scenario there would be her leavin’ the cops out of it.
lines.zh: 就是说，你把她揍个半死、她还是什么都不会告诉你，你能得到什么？最好的情况也不过是她不把警察扯进来。

lines.en: : Do you think...the cops would actually do anything if we tried to get them involved {i}now?{/i} Like, couldn’t they go do a welfare check or something?
lines.zh: 你觉得……如果我们{i}现在{/i}报警，警察真会管吗？比如，他们不能去看看他是否平安什么的？

lines.en: scene chikabigmad20
: Kumon-mi’s cops? You kidding? Force is so thin with all the dudes up there in space that you can’t even get ‘em to show up for a robbery. How the hell do you think I landed so many TVs?
lines.zh: Kumon-mi 的警察？你开玩笑吧？人都跑到太空上去了，警力薄得连抢劫都出不了警。不然你以为我哪儿来那么多电视？

lines.en: : I thought you got those on the side of the road when people were throwing them away?
lines.zh: 我还以为你是从路边捡人家扔掉的呢？

lines.en: : Yeah, cause that’s what I wanted you to think.
lines.zh: 对啊，因为我就想让你这么以为。

lines.en: : Oh god. I’m harboring a criminal.
lines.zh: 天啊。我在包庇一个罪犯。

lines.en: : Listen, if you want {i}my{/i} advice...try makin’ the guy a fuckin’ card or something.
lines.zh: 听着，你要是想听{i}我的{/i}建议……就给他做张该死的卡片什么的。

lines.en: scene chikabigmad21
: A...card?
lines.zh: 卡……卡片？

lines.en: : Yeah. You know how in movies and shit, people will band together and make a card for somebody who’s goin’ through a tough time and then, like...that person’s suddenly cured of cancer or whatever? Do that.
lines.zh: 对。你知道电影里那种，大家凑一起给正在熬难关的人做张卡片，然后……那人突然就癌症痊愈了什么的？就做那个。

lines.en: : Are you telling me Sensei has cancer?
lines.zh: 你是说 Sensei 得了癌症？

lines.en: : No, you fucking moron. I’m telling you that, like...even if the dude’s a heartless prick who preys on teenagers, he’d probably feel {i}something{/i} getting a card like that.
lines.zh: 不是，你这个白痴。我是说……就算那家伙是个专吃高中生的无情混蛋，收到那种卡片大概也会有{i}点{/i}感触。

lines.en: : Even if you all write simple shit like “Yo, miss you” or whatever. It ain’t a foolproof plan by any means, but it’s better than beatin’ the shit outta somebody, I think. And I speak from experience.
lines.zh: 就算你们只写「嘿，想你」之类简单的话也行。这绝对算不上万无一失，不过总比把人揍个半死强，我觉得。这可是经验之谈。

lines.en: : How would we get it to him, though? Because we’d have to give it to Ami and I refuse to believe she wouldn’t just tear it up or set it on fire to make sure he keeps thinking of her and her alone.
lines.zh: 可我们要怎么交给他呢？因为得让 Ami 转交，而我不信她不会直接撕了、或者烧了，好让他心里只有她一个人。

lines.en: scene chikabigmad22
: Now, {i}that{/i} I don’t know. And I’ve gotta start gettin’ ready for a thing, so I can’t brainstorm now. But I’ll text you if I think of something.
lines.zh: 这个{i}我{/i}就不知道了。而且我得去准备一件事，现在没法帮你想。不过要是我想到什么，会发短信给你。

lines.en: : A {i}thing?{/i}
lines.zh: 一件{i}事{/i}？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: 别管了。

lines.en: scene chikabigmad23
: Oh my god! You’re going to the Christmas party, aren’t you?!
lines.zh: 我的天！你要去圣诞派对，对吧？！

lines.en: : I literally just told you not to worry about it.
lines.zh: 我刚刚才说了别管。

lines.en: scene chikabigmad24
: {i}Big sis, Chika! Chinami’s been waiting a long time for the water to get hot, but it’s still cold! And she doesn’t want to take a cold bath because she’ll get a cough and then die!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chika 姐姐！Chinami 等水热等了好久，可还是凉的！而且她不想洗冷水澡，因为会咳嗽，然后死掉！{/i}

lines.en: scene chikabigmad25
: Fuck...That’s the fifth time this month.
lines.zh: 操……这个月第五次了。

lines.en: : You forget to pay the bill or some shit?
lines.zh: 你忘记缴费了还是怎么的？

lines.en: : No, I think the boiler is busted.
lines.zh: 不是，我觉得是锅炉坏了。

lines.en: : Chinami, just take a bath tomorrow! I’m sorry for making you wait in there so long!
lines.zh: Chinami，明天再洗吧！对不起，让你在里面等了那么久！

lines.en: : {i}That’s okay! Chinami played with her imaginary friend, Thomas!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}没关系！Chinami 跟她的假想朋友 Thomas 玩了！{/i}

lines.en: : Please don’t take imaginary boys into the bathroom with you, Chinami!
lines.zh: 别把假想的男孩子带进浴室，Chinami！

lines.en: : Need me to go knock some sense into your landlord? Or would you rather get some of that crazy bitch energy out and fight him yourself?
lines.zh: 要我去把你的房东揍醒吗？还是你更想发泄一下那股疯婆子劲，自己跟他干一架？

lines.en: scene chikabigmad26
: Don’t worry about it. I’ve got another Christmas present for {i}both{/i} of you that should be ready any day now. And when it is, we’ll have all the hot water we’ll ever need.
lines.zh: 别担心。我还给你们{i}俩{/i}准备了另一份圣诞礼物，这几天就该好了。等它一好，我们要多少热水就有多少。

lines.en: : You’re gonna fuckin’ burn this place to the ground, aren’t you?
lines.zh: 你是打算把这地方给烧个精光，对吧？

lines.en: : Yumi, if I don’t see my boyfriend soon, I am going to burn this entire fucking {i}city{/i} to the ground.
lines.zh: Yumi，要是再不让我见到我男朋友，我就把整座{i}城{/i}都他妈烧成平地。

lines.en: scene black
: And on that note, I’m out. Text me if you start thinking more about death and other sad stuff or whatever.
lines.zh: 那么，我走了。要是你又开始想死亡和其他悲伤的事什么的，就发短信给我。

lines.en: : Got it. Tell everybody at the party who doesn’t also love Sensei that I said hi.
lines.zh: 知道了。替我跟派对上那些同样不爱 Sensei 的人问好。

lines.en: : What’s that? You want me to talk to absolutely no one? Got it. Later.
lines.zh: 什么？你是让我一个人都别理？明白了。回见。

lines.en: : Later, Yumi.
lines.zh: 回见，Yumi。

lines.en: : And thank you...
lines.zh: 还有，谢谢你……
